import re

ACT = re.compile(r"^(?P<action>Inst|Conf|Remv|Purg) (?P<package>\S+)(?: \[(?P<current>[^\]]+)\])?(?: \((?P<version>\S+) (?P<origin>\S(?:.*?\S)?) \[(?P<arch>[^\]]+)\]\))?$")
SUM = re.compile(r"^(?P<upgraded>\d+) upgraded, (?P<newly_installed>\d+) newly installed, (?P<to_remove>\d+) to remove and (?P<not_upgraded>\d+) not upgraded\.$")
TITLE = re.compile(r"^(?P<title>(?:Suggested|Recommended) packages|The following .*?):$")
NOISE = re.compile(r"^(?:Reading package lists|Building dependency tree|Reading state information)\.\.\.")


def parse(lines):
    lists, acts, summ, l_lines, a_lines, s_lines, skip = [], [], {}, [], [], [], []
    title = None
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        if NOISE.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            title = None
            continue
        m = TITLE.match(ln)
        if m:
            title = m.group("title")
            l_lines.append(j)
            continue
        if title and ln.startswith("  "):
            for pkg in ln.split():
                lists.append({"list": title, "package": pkg})
            l_lines.append(j)
            continue
        title = None
        m = SUM.match(ln)
        if m:
            summ.update(m.groupdict())
            s_lines.append(j)
            continue
        m = ACT.match(ln)
        if m:
            acts.append({k: v or "" for k, v in m.groupdict().items()})
            a_lines.append(j)
    return {"blocks": [
        {"name": "package_lists", "kind": "table", "lines": l_lines, "records": lists},
        {"name": "summary", "kind": "kv", "lines": s_lines, "records": [summ]},
        {"name": "actions", "kind": "table", "lines": a_lines, "records": acts}],
        "skip": skip}
